newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cahya Mata has equity in new stockbroker.
newsitem.headline: Cahya Mata has equity in new stockbroker.

text.p: Malaysia's Cahya Mata Sarawak Bhd said a subsidiary is taking up a 51 percent equity in a new stockbroking company to be establised in Miri town in eastern Sarawak state.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, the industrial and financial concern said Utama Banking Group Bhd has received approval from the Finance Ministry to take up the stockbroking equity.
Cahya Mata holds direct and indirect interest of 57.23 percent stake in Utama Banking.
Cahya Mata wholly-owned another stockbroking company, Sarawak Securities in the same state.
